title: Click #3019: empty prompt_suffix adds a trailing space

environment.platform_notes: The benchmark repository uses colorama on Windows. The public report used Python 3.13; the recorded local run used Python 3.11.15, so the two environments are not identical.

issue.sanitized_problem: click.prompt and click.confirm emit one extra space when prompt_suffix is the empty string.
issue.observable_error: With prompt_suffix="" the rendered prompt line carries a trailing space that an omitted suffix does not produce.
issue.expected_behavior: An empty prompt_suffix and an omitted prompt_suffix render the same prompt line.

public_checks.notes: PYTHONPATH and DEVFLOW_CLICK_SOURCE must point at the pinned commit's src so the checkout is exercised instead of any installed Click. Only the empty-suffix parameters are expected to fail; the space-suffix parameters are the environment control. Target tests are written in the form the JUnit parser produces (`module::test[param]`): the report records `classname` as the module stem without `.py`, and the comparison matches names exactly, so a pytest node id such as `scenarios.py::test_prompt_suffix` would never match a recorded result. The parameter ids come from the manual baseline recorded below; the first automatic run must confirm them before any formal acceptance claim.

baseline.environment_note: Windows, Python 3.11.15, pytest 9.1.1, colorama 0.4.6 (preflight automatic public baseline on a clean checkout at this commit)
baseline.notes: The 2026-11-09 manual observation and the 2026-11-12 automatic preflight run agree: two declared targets failed, two controls passed, exit code 1, and the checkout stayed unmodified. A preflight baseline is not a Run-persisted baseline: every Run must still record its own pre-patch failure before a patch is considered.
